title: [GMCP 203.010.06] Operations and evidence: Complete resource server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-010-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Static and templated resources support deterministic discovery, URI completion, text and binary reads, metadata, pagination/filtering, cache semantics, list and update notifications, modern filtered subscriptions, authorization, cancellation, and bounded streaming. URI-template matching, traversal, races, stale cache, not-found semantics, MIME handling, and large-resource behavior pass positive and adversarial fixtures. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
